chapters.title: Anomaly Detection: Reading Guide
chapters.description: A short route from isolation paths to meaningful telemetry features and a measurable investigation queue.

chapters.title: Isolation Forest: Follow One Point Through a Forest
chapters.description: Follow random cuts into average path length, understand the anomaly score, and separate library score direction from alert thresholds.

chapters.title: Model Sparse, Heavy-Tailed Telemetry Without Flagging Every Large Customer
chapters.description: Build meaningful anomaly features by defining the scoring unit, comparing counts with exposure, and separating zeros from missing observations.

chapters.title: Turn Anomaly Scores into an Investigation Queue
chapters.description: Choose a practical review policy, understand precision and recall before using them, and attach anomaly evidence in the correct output units.
